Aggregator changes are counted over puzzles with a final aggregator: a change is a puzzle whose final answer (the aggregator's graded whole answer) is not the helpers' results taken in order. ``Helpers' results'' means the helpers' answers in order, at either shape; it is not the chain shape.
% note: A setting is ``not completed'' if a designed call has no final record. Settings not completed: 0.
% note: Adaptive designs (their number of calls is not fixed in advance): step voting on pieces and the Haiku team. Their designed calls are the final calls plus the calls the runner's own logic would still have made when the analysis ran: a lower bound.
% note: Picker positions are descriptive: how often each of samples 1--8 is picked; position effects are not studied.
